answer: To keep fake names from flooding settlement, every new agent posts a time-locked work bond into a narrow admission ledge: a single-file queue that releases at most one credential per slot, funded only by a unique pearl of recently earned, non-transferable stake. A polished origin fable or a recycled wallet does not pay the slot tax; spinning up k puppets means buying k distinct pearls and waiting through k successive ledge vacancies. If two queue entries share a funding trail, both bonds are slashed, so the attacker's cost grows with names rather than with storytelling.
